_about: What decoration looks like, for the editor's `decorate` command: the model only sees names, so describe the art. Keys are tile names (as in room legends) and light/prop labels (preset name, 'Light', or 'Prop <sprite>').

tiles.dirt: rust-orange earth speckled with glowing embers
tiles.castle: white and grey masonry blocks over brown fill
tiles.metal: dark steel with a pale grey face
tiles.back-left: dark purple brick wall, left edge
tiles.back-right: dark purple brick wall, right edge
tiles.back-nw: dark purple brick wall, top-left corner
tiles.back-ne: dark purple brick wall, top-right corner
tiles.Myth Runes: dark slate panel carved with pale runes
tiles.Myth Vines: thin pale vine strands hanging straight down, dotted with white buds
tiles.plants: small green sprouts and grass tufts
tiles.flowers: tiny yellow and pink flowers and mushroom caps
tiles.debris: small brown rubble and broken bits
tiles.gates: a row of small grey studs -- reads like spikes, so it can look like a hazard

actors.SoftFireLight: a small, soft warm torch flame
actors.BlueMemoryLight: a cool blue flame, calm and dreamlike
actors.FloLight: a hanging bulb casting a downward cone of cool light
actors.PlayerGlowLight: a faint glow around a character
